moved.sentence: Use `WorkManager` for all deferrable background work — it handles constraints, retries, and chaining.

judged.note: android-use-workmanager-for-deferrable-work keeps WorkManager for all deferrable work and its constraints/retries/chaining reason, scoped to Android, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Use `ForegroundService` with a persistent notification for user-visible ongoing work (music playback, navigation, uploads).

judged.note: android-use-foregroundservice-for-visible-work keeps ForegroundService with a persistent notification for user-visible ongoing work and its examples, on Android, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Respect Doze mode and App Standby buckets.

judged.note: android-respect-doze-and-standby keeps respecting Doze mode and App Standby buckets on Android, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Avoid `AlarmManager` for work that `WorkManager` can handle.

judged.note: android-avoid-alarmmanager keeps avoiding AlarmManager for work WorkManager can handle on Android, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Use `BGAppRefreshTask` and `BGProcessingTask` via the BackgroundTasks framework for deferred work.

judged.note: apple-use-bgtasks-for-deferred-work keeps BGAppRefreshTask and BGProcessingTask via BackgroundTasks for deferred work on Apple platforms, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Use `URLSession` background transfers for uploads and downloads that survive app suspension.

judged.note: apple-use-urlsession-background-transfers keeps URLSession background transfers for uploads/downloads that survive suspension on Apple platforms, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: On macOS, longer-running background work is less restricted but should still use `ProcessInfo.performActivity` to prevent App Nap.

judged.note: macos-prevent-app-nap keeps the less-restricted note and ProcessInfo.performActivity to prevent App Nap on macOS, raised from lowercase should to SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Use `NSBackgroundActivityScheduler` for periodic maintenance tasks on macOS.

judged.note: macos-use-nsbackgroundactivityscheduler keeps NSBackgroundActivityScheduler for periodic maintenance tasks on macOS, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Use the platform's sanctioned background APIs — unsanctioned workarounds get killed and drain battery

judged.note: use-sanctioned-background-apis keeps using sanctioned background APIs and the killed/battery-drain reason, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Design tasks to be resumable — background execution can be interrupted at any time

judged.note: design-tasks-to-be-resumable keeps resumable tasks and the interrupted-at-any-time reason, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Minimize resource usage — the OS budgets CPU and network time strictly

judged.note: minimize-resource-usage keeps minimizing resource usage and the strict OS CPU/network budget reason, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Report progress and completion through notifications when appropriate

judged.note: report-progress-through-notifications keeps reporting progress and completion through notifications with its when-appropriate condition, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Use Service Workers for background sync (`BackgroundSyncManager`) and push notification handling.

judged.note: web-use-service-workers keeps Service Workers for background sync (BackgroundSyncManager) and push handling on the web, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Use the Periodic Background Sync API for recurring data refresh (requires PWA install and user engagement).

judged.note: web-use-periodic-background-sync keeps the Periodic Background Sync API for recurring refresh and its PWA-install/engagement requirement, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Use Web Workers for CPU-intensive tasks that shouldn't block the UI thread.

judged.note: web-use-web-workers-for-cpu-work keeps Web Workers for CPU-intensive tasks that shouldn't block the UI thread, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Fall back to `requestIdleCallback` for low-priority deferred work.

judged.note: web-fall-back-to-requestidlecallback keeps falling back to requestIdleCallback for low-priority deferred work, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Use `BackgroundTask` with the Windows App SDK for background execution.

judged.note: windows-use-backgroundtask keeps BackgroundTask with the Windows App SDK for background execution, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Register triggers (time, network state change, push notification) in the app manifest.

judged.note: windows-register-triggers-in-manifest keeps registering time, network-state and push triggers in the app manifest, at SHOULD.
windows-use-extendedexecutionsession keeps ExtendedExecutionSession for long-running tasks on Windows, at SHOULD.
